question: NextDC parent company owner
markdown:
NEXTDC Limited is an independent, publicly traded Australian company listed on the ASX under ASX:NXT, with no parent company. Founded by Bevan Slattery in 2010, it is led by CEO Craig Scroggie. Ownership is widely held, with institutional investors owning about 43% and individual investors 56%. The company provides Data-Centre-as-a-Service and operates independent data centres in Australia.
NEXTDC Limited does not have a parent company; it is an independent, publicly traded enterprise listed on the Australian Securities Exchange under the ticker ASX:NXT.
NEXTDC is a public company founded by Bevan Slattery in May 2010.
NEXTDC is managed by Craig Scroggie, who serves as the Chief Executive Officer and Managing Director.
NEXTDC's ownership is widely held by a mix of institutional investors (owning roughly 43%) and individual or private investors, with no single parent corporation controlling the entity.
Individual investors account for 56% of NEXTDC Limited's shares.
NEXTDC (ASX:NXT) is an Australian Data-Centre-as-a-Service provider.
NEXTDC is publicly owned and listed on the Australian Securities Exchange under ASX:NXT.
NEXTDC Limited is an Australia-based technology company engaged in the development and operation of independent data centres.
